title: EU, OSCE Missions Criticise Kosovo's Demolition of Serb-Owned Villas
description: EU and OSCE regret bulldozing of allegedly illegally-built Serb villas near important lake, urging authorities to respect due process and the property rights of all the communities in the country.

title: ‘I would have ethnically cleansed Kosovo in 1998’, says Serbian minister – opening a Balkan Pandora’s Box
description: Behind the outrage over one minister’s words lies a deeper, unspoken reality laid bare by diplomats and experts: Belgrade never really buried the Milošević-era narrative about Kosovo, it just learned to speak it more quietly in Brussels.

title: Who is Mykhailo Drapatyi, Ukraine's new commander-in-chief?
description: Drapatyi becomes Ukraine's third commander-in-chief since Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022.

title: Ukrainian drones hit more sites of Russian online giant retailer Wildberries
description: Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions were struck overnight.

title: Germany to grant Kosovo 5 mln euro for power grid upgrades
description: Kosovo's finance ministry said on Wednesday it has signed an agreement with German development bank KFW to support the implementation of an ongoing project for the upgrade of the country's power grid with a 5 million euro ($5.7 million) grant.

title: Wizz Air opens base in Kosovo's Pristina
description: Hugarian low cost carrier Wizz Air inaugurated its newly established base in Kosovo's capital Pristina on Wednesday, prime minister Albin Kurti said.

title: Morgan Rogers ‘so happy’ after joining Chelsea in record British deal
description: The 23-year-old Rogers, one of the Premier League’s top attacking talents, has signed a contract until 2033.

title: Austrian police station opens at Hitler's birthplace in bid to rid site of Nazi link
description: The opening follows years of controversy about what to do with the 17th-Century former inn, where the Nazi dictator was born.
